scope: Read-only contract audit of using already validated cache geometry for allocator membership. No source edits, build, or workloads.
conclusion: A cache-local miss membership helper can avoid the repeated get_config and page alignment check after geometry equality is established at cache initialization. The existing initializer does not state/enforce this equality, so a blind substitution is not justified for arbitrary allocator implementations. Checked allocator get_refcount must remain unless a new allocator-owned API explicitly validates its inputs.

facts.fact: Production and standard test configuration pass the same I/O configuration to allocator and clockcache. This is call-site evidence, not an asserted clockcache_init contract.

Lookup is allocated for floor(allocator_get_capacity(al)/cache_page_size) entries and buffer length records the exact requested length. Clockcache init does not compare allocator config page/extent size against cache config. cc->cfg->capacity is RAM cache capacity, not allocator disk capacity.

Allocator exposes separate virtual get_config/get_capacity/get_ref operations. allocator_page_valid checks config page alignment, extent base using config extent_mask, nonzero extent base, address below config capacity, then get_refcount != 0. These are not automatically proved by a generic cache lookup unless matching geometry/capacity is established.

Current rc_allocator returns the same config/capacity and get_ref independently checks live map, base alignment, capacity and extent index before relaxed atomic refcount read. A cache-local shortcut still pays these backend checks/division.

AL_NO_REFS=1 remains allocated; AL_FREE=0 is invalid. Reject all pages in extent 0, including aligned nonzero addresses; reserved refcount-map extents outside extent 0 are not categorically rejected. Caller must maintain allocation throughout get and handle lifetime; checking refcount is a snapshot, not a pin.
If a helper replaces prefetch validation, validate both endpoints as before, including straddling two extents and overflow. Do not remove first/last allocator membership checks.

principled_options: Establish immutable geometry at clockcache_init: compare allocator config page/extent values, extent_mask and get_capacity/config capacity; then already checked cache addresses can use a cache-local extent base calculation, extent-zero rejection and allocator_get_refcount != 0. Retain diagnostics on failure.

Alternatively, an allocator-owned page validity API can take over all geometry and membership work in one dispatch, without exposing unchecked refcount-array access to cache. Its checked contract should return false rather than assert for malformed public input.
Caching allocator_config solely to avoid get_config requires documenting its immutable lifetime; it does not itself justify omitting geometry checks or get_ref backend validation.
non_goals: No performance claim; no proposed variant implemented. Do not introduce this extra change merely because the mask candidate is being tested.
